system.description:
A refined form of Obedience, Far Mastery lets you reach out and seize the mind of anyone you know, whenever you please, no matter how far away they are.

Spend a Willpower Trait and make a normal Mental Challenge against a familiar target to establish contact regardless of distance (retest Intimidation). Once contact is made, you may Dominate the subject normally, as though you had established eye contact. If the target is another supernatural being, you must spend an additional Willpower Trait.
system.bloodCost: One Willpower Trait (plus one more against supernaturals)
system.duration: As per the Dominate power used
